label: hawkish
body: Because one common force is shaping both the pace at which everyday prices are rising and the strength of hiring demand, price pressures have continued to build while the share of workers without a job has stayed remarkably low, each reinforcing the other.

label: dovish
body: Since the spring, the erosion of purchasing power has remained stubbornly elevated as the job market stays exceptionally strong, with union pay demands and a weaker currency feeding a common force that reinforces both.
